about: Fixed persona scenarios for `make vhs-scenarios` (see demos/README.md). Each entry is one Zero Trust Paper Company employee doing a day-to-day task through a governed agent. Prompts, people, roles and records come from demos/zero-trust-paper-company (README.md, SCENARIOS.md, seed.py). `calls` are the only API calls the small local model is told about; each must be answerable from the seeded data. Edit a prompt to tailor a take; the order is the recording order. Run locally only: no CI workflow runs this.

scenarios.title: Priya Shah, Controller: chasing the overdue invoice
scenarios.prompt: I am Priya Shah, the controller. Which customer invoice is past due, and how much is still outstanding?
scenarios.shows: Past-due list: INV-1001 for Acorn, $249.90 invoiced, $50.00 paid, $199.90 outstanding. Read-only finance call, signed MCP_CALL receipt.

scenarios.title: Alex Chen, Operations: the morning stock check
scenarios.prompt: I am Alex in operations. Which paper products are low on stock, and should I reorder anything?
scenarios.shows: Warehouse stock with reorder points (recycled paper 65 cartons vs reorder point 70; wrap below its point of 20). Also adds the thinking scene: qwen3:0.6b thinks through governed inference and the signed thinking is shown.

scenarios.title: Jamie Park, Procurement: checking the Northstar contract
scenarios.prompt: I am Jamie in procurement. Find our Northstar supplier contract and tell me what it covers.
scenarios.shows: Confidential retrieval: DOC-201 returns to procurement with a paragraph citation (the public role sees nothing). Open purchase orders PO-1001 and PO-1002 already cover the shortages.

scenarios.title: Sam Rivera, Support: where is Beacon's order?
scenarios.prompt: I am Sam in support. Beacon Community School is asking where its order is. Check ticket TKT-1002 and the delivery route. Tell me the status without guessing a delivery time.
scenarios.shows: Ticket TKT-1002 is pending with one reply; ORD-1002 is loaded on the Eastside school run (RTE-1001). The data holds schedule, not a live ETA, so a good answer does not invent one.

scenarios.title: Morgan Reed, Compliance: can operations read payroll?
scenarios.prompt: I am Morgan Reed, the compliance reviewer. Verify that the operations role cannot read payroll: request the payroll endpoint as operations and tell me whether it was allowed.
scenarios.shows: The denied path: the governed call is admitted and receipted, and the application answers 403 forbidden (SCENARIOS.md section 7). Evidence of the refusal lands in the signed receipts and audit chain.
